title: Week 34
subtitle: Six weeks left. The group B strep swab is next week.

baby.size: About the size of a cantaloupe
baby.development: The lungs are nearly mature. The baby's fingernails are fully formed and the skin is smooth. The central nervous system is maturing fast, and the baby can grip.

you.body: Your uterus is about five and a half inches above your belly button. You may have more pelvic pressure, more swelling, and more trouble sleeping. You may feel the baby drop in the next few weeks.
you.mind: You may be ready for this to be over, and also not ready at all. Both are true at once for most people.

coreActions.title: Get the group B strep swab
coreActions.why: It is a five-minute swab that prevents a serious infection in a newborn. It is the single most useful test in the last month.
coreActions.detail: The swab goes in the vagina and rectum. It does not hurt. Results take a few days. If it is positive, you get antibiotics through an IV in labor, and that is the whole treatment. Being positive is common and it is not a sign of anything you did.

options.label: At a scheduled visit
options.detail: Ask the front desk to add it.

options.label: Ask your OB to do it today
options.detail: If you are already there, it takes a minute.

coreActions.skipIf: You have already had the swab this pregnancy.

coreActions.title: Know the signs of preterm labor
coreActions.why: Before 37 weeks, the difference between a call and a wait can be a hospital stay. Knowing the signs means you call sooner.
coreActions.detail: Regular contractions that get closer together, fluid leaking, bleeding, low back pain that comes in waves, or a feeling of pressure low down. If any of these happen before 37 weeks, call your OB's after-hours line. Do not wait to see if it stops.

options.label: Read the signs
options.detail: Two minutes. Worth knowing by heart.

options.label: Save the after-hours number
options.detail: In your phone, under a name you will find at 3am.

coreActions.skipIf: You already know the signs and have the number saved.

coreActions.title: Put the bag in the car
coreActions.why: A bag by the door is good. A bag in the car is better, because the door is not where you will be when it starts.
coreActions.detail: Check the bag has the charger, the ID, and the insurance card. Put the car seat in and check the install one more time. Leave a note on the fridge with the hospital address and the after-hours number for whoever is watching the house or the pets.

options.label: Add the fridge note
options.detail: Hospital address, after-hours number, pet instructions.

coreActions.skipIf: The bag is already in the car.

alsoKnow.title: The baby dropping is called lightening
alsoKnow.body: It happens in the last weeks for some people and not at all for others. Breathing gets easier and peeing gets more frequent. It is not a sign labor is starting.

alsoKnow.title: Antibiotics in labor are a small interruption
alsoKnow.body: They go through an IV every four hours. You can still move, eat if allowed, and use the tub at most hospitals. It does not commit you to anything else.

alsoKnow.title: Plan for the pets now
alsoKnow.body: Who feeds them, who walks them, and who has a key. A neighbor with a key and a written note is worth more than a perfect plan.

redFlags.text: Fluid that keeps leaking, or any vaginal bleeding
A clear change in your baby's usual movement

appointments.label: Group B strep swab
appointments.note: Quick swab. Results in a few days.
